featured_reviews.name: Khushi Nada
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently got best-friend tattoos (all three of us!), and it was a totally last-minute plan. Even though we weren’t prepared at all, they guided us through everything…from choosing the right size to explaining long-term results, consequences, and how to get the best outcome. All the information they shared felt honest and genuine. We did very small design since we were in lack of time but we got to see their works of fullbody and all the other…worth it.

Before starting their own studio, they had already worked at one of the best tattoo places, so this setup is truly their own initiative and not the work of beginners. They’re experienced artists who decided to follow their dream and build something of their own, and it clearly shows in their confidence and skill.

During the tattoo session, they handled us so well. One of us was getting a tattoo for the first time, and they made the entire process feel easy and comfortable. The timing was smooth, and nothing felt rushed. Their aftercare instructions were very clear and professional too.

What really stood out was how welcoming they were. There was no awkwardness at all…the conversation flowed naturally, which honestly helped a lot during the process.
The studio setup is great…clean, well-furnished, and such a good vibe. And yes… they even have a PS5 🤯 for people waiting while their partner or friends get tattooed! (I KNOW RIGHT!!!)

The music and overall atmosphere made it feel less like a studio and more like a chill hangout spot.

Overall, they’re warm, welcoming, yet extremely professional.

Also, the artist has been featured in newyork magazines…don’t forget to check out his awkwardly nice photo cause Both of them truly deserve all the love and appreciation.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
This review made us smile so much ✨
We’re really glad your last-minute plan turned into such a comfortable, fun, and meaningful experience. Thank you for noticing the care, honesty, and vibe, we loved having all three of you at the studio! 🤍

featured_reviews.name: Gargi Bhosale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I got my tattoo here two days ago and I genuinely had the best experience from start to finish! ✨ Even when I first walked in just to enquire about the tattoo and the whole process, everything was explained so patiently and clearly. There was absolutely no pressure or urgency to book immediately, which made me feel really comfortable and confident about the whole experience 🤍

When I came in for the tattoo, the team was incredibly helpful throughout the entire process. They took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and guided me through everything  from selecting the colours and size to suggesting placements. I was given so many options and really helpful advice, which I appreciated a lot 🫶🏻

The tattoo process itself took only around 45 minutes and was surprisingly comfortable ✨ The entire experience felt so smooth, welcoming, and professional. They also explained the aftercare in so much detail and made sure I understood everything properly, which honestly showed how much they care about their clients and their work 🤍

And to make it even better, I was greeted by their adorable little doggo the moment I entered the studio 🥹🐶

I’m absolutely in love with my tattoo now and so glad I decided to get it done here ❤️ Thank you for such an amazing experience!! Definitely recommending this place 🌟
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Gargi, this was such a lovely read 🖤 Thank you for taking the time to share your experience in so much detail. We're really happy that you felt comfortable from the very first visit, that's exactly how we want people to feel when they walk into the studio.

It was genuinely fun working on your tattoo and helping you figure out all the little details. And we're very glad our tiny furry temporary receptionist did her job well too ✨

Loved having you at the studio, and we're so happy you trusted us with your tattoo. Wishing you an easy heal and hope to see you again soon! ❤️
